customer_impact: No verified customer or production runtime impact. CI evidence is unavailable for affected candidates, so release gates remain fail-closed.

github.note: bounded retry reproduced the same pre-execution signature
unrelated PR and workflow reproduced the same signature

railway.interpretation: The external CI failure does not correlate with a hosted customer-proof runtime outage.

observed_evidence.public_provider_context: GitHub public status reported Actions operational during the investigation; this does not rule out a repository/account-specific control-plane or policy condition.

causal_timeline.event: Security and identity workflows began and failed before runner assignment or any job step.
An unrelated Autonomous Integration Fabric workflow on a separate PR failed with the same zero-step, runner_id=0 signature.
A bounded retry of the security gate reproduced the same pre-execution failure in three seconds.

root_cause.current_inference: Repository/account/provider CI control-plane or policy layer; exact cause unknown.

prevention_rule.detector: A completed failure with zero steps and no assigned runner is pre-execution evidence, not application/test execution evidence.
prevention_rule.correlation: If two or more unrelated workflows reproduce the signature, classify the CI plane as systemically unavailable for release evidence. If a retry also reproduces it, mark the condition persistent.
prevention_rule.product_behavior: Do not label a product regression unless at least one relevant test step actually executed.

recovery_runbook: Do not weaken or bypass security, identity, provenance or release gates.
Do not repeatedly consume retries as a substitute for diagnosis; one bounded retry is sufficient to establish persistence.
Investigate repository/account/provider Actions policy, entitlement, billing/spend and runner-provisioning controls through authorized administrative channels.
Require a previously affected critical workflow to receive a runner and execute steps normally.
Require a second unrelated critical workflow to execute normally before declaring the CI plane recovered.
Require the security and identity release gates to complete normally on the candidate before using CI as release evidence again.

metrics.prevention_coverage_change: Added deterministic distinction between CI pre-execution unavailability and executed product/test failure, with cross-workflow and retry correlation.
